name: Streamlit in Snowflake
sku: Streamlit in Snowflake, as included in the Snowflake platform. The Native App Framework is not scored.

serve.data-apps.note: Builds, deploys and shares Streamlit apps inside Snowflake, with Snowflake managing compute and storage. App source is stored as Snowflake objects under role-based access control, and apps run on either a warehouse or a container runtime.

presentation.tagline: Streamlit data apps that run next to the data, under Snowflake's access model.
